originals.citation: Eitam, B., Yeshurun, Y., & Hassan, K. (2013). Blinded by irrelevance: Pure irrelevance induced 'blindness'. Journal of Experimental Psychology: Human Perception and Performance, 39(3), 611-615.

quote: At variance with this claim of load theory, Eitam et al. (2013) used a very simple, undemanding, low-load one-trial task and nonetheless observed the blocking of bottom-up selection of irrelevant information.
notes: Abstract: 'leaving the encoding displays as in the original study ... results only partly replicated prior findings'.
